description: Code quality lint rules for Java — enforces structured logging, typed generics, and immutability

rules.description: No System.out.println in production Java — use SLF4J
rules.message: Replace System.out with a SLF4J logger: log.info("{}", value)

rules.description: Avoid raw generic types — always parameterize
rules.message: Raw type detected — parameterize the generic: List<String>, Map<String, Object>

rules.description: Mark parameters and locals final when not reassigned
rules.message: Consider marking this field final if it is never reassigned after construction
